facts.value: As part of your program at our Department of Economics, you can complete certain modules at other departments, so-called import modules from other departments - including optional modules. This is only possible based on existing cooperation agreements between the departments.
facts.programme_association: Supplementary Courses - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: For the programs of the Department of Economics, the following overview is compiled regarding which import modules you can register at other departments and how you can incorporate these import modules into your program at the Department of Economics. Furthermore, you cannot incorporate other modules from other departments into your program at the Department of Economics and also cannot earn differing credit points (CP).
